substeps.caption: Breakers and main switch on. Everything else is still off.
Facility chilled water: open the valve only a little (at least 2 L/min, but 'water too cold' trips below 7–10 °C).
Heat exchanger on only when you are about to heat; wait for 'cooling water flow low' to clear.
Compressed air: 8 bar supply, about 4 bar regulated. It only cools the transducer, but no air means no ultrasonics.
Argon 5N at 8 bar on the regulator (0–10 bar, not a welding regulator): one T into the furnace line and the chamber line; it also drives the pneumatics.
Checklist: vacuum-pump oil in the sight glass, exchanger water level, HEPA filter (every ~2 months), hoses dry.
